sources.title: Introducing Claude Haiku 5.5
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27, 2026. Exact October 7 launch identifies claude-haiku-5-5. Its comparison table reports benchmark scores; small/fastest and cost comparisons give no nominal parameter size or named sized base.

sources.title: Claude Haiku 5.5 overview
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27, 2026. Exact-model specifications and current comparison table include Haiku 5.5, Fable 5.1, Opus 5.5 and Sonnet 5.5, with context, output, pricing, latency, thinking and knowledge-cutoff columns, but no total or activated-parameter column. Shared newer tokenizer is not a shared-weight or sized-base claim.

sources.title: System Card: Claude Haiku 5.5
sources.evidence: 144-page October 7, 2026 card obtained via curl from the official system-card redirect. Page 8 names Anthropic and Haiku-class model, describes training and text-only output. Full-text inspection found no parameter-count or architecture disclosure; parameter mentions concern effort settings.

sources.title: Model system cards
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27, 2026. Current index still lists Haiku 5.5 (October 2026) as its latest card, followed by September Sonnet/Opus 5.5; no later card listed. Current live model comparison tables were separately checked for new count disclosures.

sources.title: Anthropic Transparency Hub: Claude Haiku 5.5 summary
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27, 2026. Haiku 5.5 summary describes pretraining on diverse datasets and subsequent post-training, plus text/image input and text output. It provides no nominal total, active count or named sized backbone. Capability and risk comparisons are not parameter specifications.

sources.title: PDF support
sources.evidence: All active models support PDF processing, represented internally as page images with extracted text; Haiku 5.5 is explicitly active in its model overview.

sources.title: Claude Haiku 5.5 migration guide
sources.evidence: Exact-model guide states fixed claude-haiku-5-5 identifier with no separate alias; documents forced tool choice, tool calls, computer use and browser tools.

sources.title: Commercial Terms of Service
sources.evidence: API access is licensed service use, subject to restrictions; Anthropic retains intellectual-property rights except those expressly granted. Supports proprietary classification together with exact-model hosted availability.

sources.title: GLM-5.3 and the spread of advanced cyber capabilities
sources.evidence: September 29, 2026 research states Claude weights are not publicly released or customizable. General Claude distribution evidence, used with the later Haiku 5.5 hosted-only launch rather than as exact-model architectural evidence.

sources.title: Models.dev Claude Haiku 5.5 record
sources.evidence: Baseline catalog link inspected as a lead; technical claims independently checked against Anthropic sources.

sources.title: Claude Haiku 5.5 System Card — fresh parameter review
sources.evidence: Fresh official PDF cached at 2026-10-27T10:11:48.624710+00:00; independently inspected its full extracted text for count and lineage terms, with introduction/training and comparison sections read in context. Page 8 describes Haiku 5.5 pretraining followed by post-training/fine-tuning, without identifying a differently named sized base. Page 111 Table 8.1.A is a capability-score comparison, not a parameter table. Pages 125 and 127 explicitly use effort to vary test-time compute; no nominal total or activated count is given.

sources.title: Claude Haiku 4.5 System Card — predecessor lineage check
sources.evidence: Fresh official PDF cached at 2026-10-27T10:11:46.552765+00:00; full-text parameter/size/lineage search and introduction/training inspection. Pages 4–5 describe a smaller, faster new model and its own pretraining/post-training; no nominal total or active count is provided. Haiku 5.5 calls this its predecessor, which establishes succession rather than equal weights or a sized base.

sources.title: Claude Sonnet 5.5 System Card — sibling comparison check
sources.evidence: Fresh official PDF cached at 2026-10-27T10:11:47.935884+00:00; full extracted-text count/lineage checks found no Haiku 5.5 nominal total/active disclosure or sized-base relationship. Parameter mentions concern effort and test-time compute; the card precedes Haiku 5.5.

sources.title: Claude Opus 5.5 System Card — sibling comparison check
sources.evidence: Fresh official PDF cached at 2026-10-27T10:11:48.808248+00:00; full extracted-text count/lineage checks found no Haiku 5.5 nominal total/active disclosure or sized-base relationship. Parameter mentions concern evaluation harness settings or effort; the card precedes Haiku 5.5.

sources.title: Claude models overview — current comparison table
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27, 2026. Current table explicitly includes claude-haiku-5-5 and compares latency, prices, thinking, effort, context/output limits, dates and IDs, with no nominal or activated-parameter column. Focused fresh exact-name searches for parameters, billion/activated sizes, distillation and named base lineage found no additional primary count disclosure; provider search hits showed token usage, not model parameter counts.

name.note: Exact official release name and fixed API model identifier match the record.

developer.note: System-card introduction identifies Anthropic as the developer.

family.note: Catalog-normalized family; executive summary explicitly calls this a Haiku-class model.

release_date.note: Launch announcement, model overview and system-card cover explicitly agree on October 7, 2026.

open_weights.note: Exact launch offers hosted Claude and cloud/API access; consistent with Anthropic public statement that Claude weights are not released to users. No weight distribution is offered.

license.note: Descriptive service/model licensing classification, not an SPDX weight license. API use is governed by Anthropic commercial terms and no public model weights are distributed.

parameters_b.note: No nominal total count is disclosed in the freshly checked exact card, launch, transparency summary or current comparison tables. Haiku 4.5 is a predecessor, not an explicitly identified same-weight sized base; neither its card nor the Sonnet/Opus 5.5 cards supplies an inferable size.

active_parameters_b.note: No activated-parameter count or count convention is published in the checked exact card or current comparison tables. Effort adjusts test-time compute and benchmark tables report capability scores; neither supplies a per-token parameter count.

architecture.note: Card and transparency hub describe training but not network structure. Exact-name searches on Anthropic research and transformer-circuits.pub did not locate architectural disclosure. No sibling-model structure is transferred.

context_window.note: Exact-model capability table reports 1M tokens, normalized to 1,000,000.

modalities.note: Overview confirms text/image input and text output; all active models support PDF processing. PDF is an accepted document format handled through text and images.

reasoning.note: Adaptive thinking explicitly supported and enabled by default.

tool_call.note: Exact-model migration guide explicitly documents forced tool_choice, emitted tool calls and computer/browser tools.

description.value: Fast Claude model for responsive assistance, classification, and lightweight agents
description.note: Concise summary supported by official speed-sensitive support, classification and narrowly scoped subagent use cases; lightweight refers to task scope, not an asserted parameter count.

patch.notes: Anthropic has not disclosed nominal total or active parameter counts in the checked sources. The Haiku 4.5 predecessor relationship does not establish a sized base; effort settings describe test-time compute.

summary: Fresh October 27 parameter-only re-audit retains null/undisclosed total and active counts after reopening the launch, exact specifications, Transparency Hub and card index; independently checking the exact 144-page card, Haiku 4.5 predecessor and Sonnet/Opus 5.5 sibling cards; and reviewing current official comparison tables. No named sized-base relationship or separate activated-parameter column was found. Focused exact-name searches yielded no additional primary count disclosure; effort and benchmark figures are not parameter sizes. Prior non-parameter assessments and corrections are preserved.
